title: Ordained by Sun and Moon
summary: The Silver Fang claim to rule the Garou Nation.

claims.text: Silver Fang lore says the tribe took up a human style of rule ordained by the Sun while still pledging its victories and stories to Luna.
Fangs hold that winning Falcon's promise made them the only tribe blessed by both Sun and Moon, and they see this as the root of their right to lead.
Their tales remember Arak Mammoth-Bold as a great king and master tactician who died leading attacks on a manifestation of the Beast-of-War.

title: The Mother Country
summary: Russia and its Silver Fangs in the modern nights.

claims.text: Fangs say real power in many nations still lies with an unseen aristocracy of the wealthy and well connected, which lets the tribe keep its old privilege hidden.
In the Mother Country, after long dark years and recent wars, Queen Tamara Tvarivich leads the tribe toward a new era of power.
The Russian Fangs' totem, Firebird, is kin to Phoenix and is said to foresee the Final Battle.

title: The Silver Fang Houses
summary: How bloodline and place shaped the tribe's houses.

claims.text: Silver Fang houses were once defined by bloodline, which followed the lands each house settled after leaving the Mother Country.
Today bloodline counts for less: Kin scattered by migration bear cubs far from their house's septs, and many join whichever house takes them in.
House Wyrmfoe holds lands in the American northeast, while House Wise Heart traditionally ruled the Mediterranean and Middle East.

title: Silver Fang Kin and Ancestors
summary: How the tribe keeps its bloodlines and remembers its kings.

claims.text: Some septs keep Kin-Fetches watching their Kinfolk for up to three generations, so that new Garou are found before their First Change goes wrong.
In the last century, especially in America and House Unbreakable Hearth, Fangs began choosing Kin for honesty, courage and ambition and not only wealth or lineage.
Dead kings and lords of the tribe dwell in the Summer Lands of the Umbra, attended by Sun spirits, and answer when the need is great.
